configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Standalone CoreGame configure (adds ../../Engine). One build tree per preset; every tree stages its binaries into Binaries/<Platform>_<Config>[_<Target>].

configurePresets.name: editor-debug
configurePresets.description: NimbleEditor and CoreGame with WITH_EDITOR=1, unoptimised.

configurePresets.name: editor-relwithdebinfo
configurePresets.description: NimbleEditor and CoreGame with WITH_EDITOR=1, optimised with debug info.

configurePresets.name: client-debug
configurePresets.description: CoreGame with WITH_EDITOR=0, unoptimised. No editor is built.

configurePresets.name: client-relwithdebinfo
configurePresets.description: CoreGame with WITH_EDITOR=0, optimised with debug info.

configurePresets.name: client-shipping
configurePresets.description: CoreGame with WITH_EDITOR=0 and NIMBLE_SHIPPING=1: optimised, no debug info. The Editor has no Shipping build.

configurePresets.name: server-relwithdebinfo-msvc
configurePresets.description: The dedicated server and the game module with WITH_EDITOR=0, optimised with debug info, by MSVC (VS2022; from a developer prompt). What Collaboration's content worker builds on Windows. No tests (NIMBLE_BUILD_TESTS off for every server preset).

configurePresets.name: server-relwithdebinfo-clang
configurePresets.description: The dedicated server and the game module with WITH_EDITOR=0, optimised with debug info, by clang and lld (Linux, WSL included). What Collaboration's content worker builds elsewhere. No tests (NIMBLE_BUILD_TESTS off for every server preset).
